test_fillna_scalar: test the Series.fillna method to fill NA values with a scalar value
test_fillna_dict: test the Series.fillna method to fill NA values at specific indices using a dictionary
test_fillna_series_align: test the Series.fillna method to fill NA values by aligning with another Series
test_ffill_bfill: test the Series.ffill and Series.bfill methods for forward-fill and backfill operations
test_fillna_categorical: test the Series.fillna method on Categorical Series with valid and invalid fill values
test_fillna_datetime_timedelta: test the Series.fillna method on datetime64 and timedelta64 Series with various fill types
test_fillna_limit: test the Series.fillna method with a limit parameter to restrict number of filled values
test_fillna_inplace: test the Series.fillna method with inplace=True to modify the Series in place
